newsitem.title: ITALY: Eni prospectus seen ready by Friday.
newsitem.headline: Eni prospectus seen ready by Friday.

text.p: The prospectus for the third tranche offer of shares in Italian state energy group Eni should be formally presented to market regulator Consob by the end of this week, financial sources said on Monday.
Financial sources said they expected the third bloc of shares in Eni's privatisation to go on sale from June 23.
"By the end of the week, Thursday or Friday, the prospectus will be presented to Consob," one source told Reuters.
A presentation to analysts was expected on Tuesday.
The source said the calendar for the operation still had to be worked out and a decision on how much of the company the Treasury intended to sell was not expected until June.

The Treasury has 69 percent of Eni and Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi has said the state's holding will not fall below 51 percent. Analysts have said they expect ENI to follow its usual pattern of offering a tranche of about 15 percent.

A successful Eni second tranche sale in November 1996 raised 8.87 trillion lire ($5.13 billion) after the exercise of an over-allotment, or "green shoe" option because of heavy demand. The Treasury offered an initial 15 percent stake in November 1995.
